items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] We got a letter from Gussie Miller when Pocket died.

ctx.x: I mustered up the man and I got two men pretty good on reading, given the main parts. And believe me or not, brother, we went there. We went to town. Because the boys that I had liked his shield back, I say, Bucket and those fellas like that, you know. We got a, we got a little. The miniatures pop up on something, it seemed like you knew just what key and everything else you were gonna go into. It seemed to me that way now. I don't know, I might be wrong. But by God, they'd go right along with it. How much?
We got a letter from Gussie Miller when Pocket died. Oh yeah, Gussie's living too.
Gussie Miller's living too. Yeah, he sent us a nice letter.
